item.title: Sri Lanka invites explorers to assess four Mannar Basin blocks
item.description: The Sri Lankan government, through the PDASL, has invited qualified energy companies to assess four offshore exploration blocks in the Mannar Basin under its 2026 licensing round, SL2026-01.

item.title: Market Expectations Shift Towards Prolonged USA-Iran Conflict
item.description: Market expectations are shifting towards a prolonged U.S.-Iran conflict, Standard Chartered Bank Energy Research Head Emily Ashford warned.

item.title: Borr Drilling to sell 51% stake in Perfomex to Mexican partner
item.description: Borr Drilling has signed definitive agreements to sell its 51% equity interest in the Mexican well services joint venture (JV) Perfomex to its local partner.

item.title: Aker BP Makes New North Sea Gas Discovery
item.description: Aker BP discovered natural gas with preliminary estimates of about 5.3-84.8 million cubic feet on Norway's side of the North Sea, some 16 miles north of the producing Duva field.

item.title: TotalEnergies and Mistral launch oil and gas AI partnership
item.description: TotalEnergies has entered into a three-year partnership with French AI company Mistral to develop AI models for oil and gas reservoir exploration and engineering.

item.title: No Trump Truce Seen as Kyiv Hits Volga Refinery
item.description: Ukraine said it hit the Syzran refinery in Russia's Volga region, underlining that the two nations have not signed up to the energy truce claimed by U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Halliburton wins well services contract for Eni’s Cronos project
item.description: Halliburton has been awarded a contract by Eni to provide a bundled package of well construction and completions services for the Cronos project offshore Cyprus.
